claim: When the RNG or LD A,R depends on timing, neutralise it in both test copies (make it constant, LD A,I, or NOP the seed step) and cover every R read, or build and original play different games.

evidence.text: First pace runs left the RNG in and diverged at update 3; the fixture fixed it.
BA58 INC HL made NOP in both copies keeps pace runs in lockstep (test copies only).
LD A,R decides the elves' moves and R runs during HALT; a fixture making those reads constant keeps lockstep.
ROM-read RNG parts a 128K-ROM game from a Sinclair-ROM build, so random spawns differ.
LD A,R at 0x9466: pace by seed varied -25% to +18% over 8 JNext seeds; replay pace is the like-for-like figure.
A full-snapshot scan found a third LD A,R that the first list missed.
